set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 0. Name the exact committed migration baseline: Git commit, Scala version, module graph, committed bridge, and prerequisite branch commits. Inventory every production cross-domain import, live numerical reconstruction route, LNA transform and valid composition, representation family, and manifest variant. Freeze provenance-bearing compatibility fixtures for dense, quant, delta, explicit, temporal DCT, temporal Haar, shared-basis, transport, and BOLDZip paths with raw-bit, ULP, or absolute/relative comparators. Resolve D1-D4 and D6-D10, including the pure FmriDataset versus OpenedDataset[F] boundary, directly owned Double ResponseBlock with no tensor framework, decode program, time authority, canonical values, duplicates, receipts, sample geometry references, and axis-keyed locality. D5 artifact naming is the only deferred gate. Acceptance: bridge and frozen corpus pass; no source moves; every responsibility has an owner; the target DAG and baseline are exact; no decision is hidden inside a later feature ticket.
